content: Vǝlgah shahshah vak shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl
Ndakwan ciya, zaraabahaara, tǝghǝr kǝ vǝlga Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla, ǝn nai am ndzan kwal sǝrgasǝrg biya.
Ndzam sǝrgasǝrǝg taakiya ma sarta kwa ndzam tǝ kǝrdi nǝ uurama, valakurda dǝ valǝg nǝ uuda, ndzam ɓagar kwatǝnahǝr kǝ ghǝllah kwar maay dǝ shifǝg biya.

Aɗabad kwaha ǝn naagaan am nǝghaakan taakiya, maay daddakwa ɓa tlǝr Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl dǝ iin da taakiya, “Tlafatlafan nǝ Yesu biya!” Dlaɓa maay wa tagdatag taakiya, “Yesu Yaazhigǝl biya,” bamma daddakwa Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl wa ɓa tlǝr dǝ iina.
Mǝnng vǝlgah shahshaha, ba Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl pall wa vǝlgaan baɗǝmma.
Mǝnng ɗuula ɓa tlǝr shahshaha, ba Yaazhigǝl pall wa ɓagvara.
Mǝnng tlǝrah shahshaha, amma ba Daadamazhigǝl pall wa vǝlgar ndzǝɗa ɓagaan kǝ uudah baɗǝmma.
Nǝghǝvaakanǝghǝg ndzǝgana Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl ma aanji kwar kǝ uud tǝdvad tlǝrahi ar ɓag nǝ iitǝr kiyava mǝltru kǝ uudah baɗǝmma.
Mǝnng wana vǝlavar dǝga tsaga dabariya tǝdvad Shǝɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla, kwaktlǝrn dlaɓa vǝlavar dǝga tsaga ard sǝrgasǝrgǝr tǝdvad kwannǝn kǝ Shǝɗkwa.
Kwatlǝrn dlaɓa vǝlavar dǝga fadǝghǝr tǝdvad kwan nǝ iin kǝ Shǝɗǝkwa, kwatlǝrna vǝlavar dǝga mbaha uudah tǝdvad shǝɗǝkw na,

Kwatlǝrna dlaɓa vǝlavar ɓa tlǝraha dǝga jappǝrra, kwanaa dǝga tlayanngǝra, kwatlǝrna dlaɓa tagwarzhatagw kǝ ndzǝgana shǝɗǝkwaha, kwatlǝrna dǝga sǝrga taa ghai shahshaha, kwatlǝrn dlaɓa dǝga gwiya ghaiyah shahshaha.
Baɗǝm wanahaan ba Shǝɗǝkw pall wa ɓagaana, dlaɓa ba iin wa tagwartagw kǝ uud dǝ naaga ghǝraana.
Baɗǝmamiyam kiyam ba uuɓiya vǝgh palla
Bandkwa ba pall nǝ vǝgha, dlaɓa uuɓiyah tǝvakai ba ɗyaka, aanji ba mǝnng nǝ uuɓiyah ba ɗyaka, ar ba vǝgh palla. Bandkwah ci kǝ Kǝristi.

Aɗaba ɓagakiyamaɓag nǝ uud kǝ tsuufǝg baɗǝmmamiyam tǝdvad Shǝɗǝkw pall damma vǝgh palla, aanji Yahuudaha aanji lii Yahuudah biya, ma ɛɛva nǝ iina bi dadda kwara ghǝraana, baɗǝmmamiyama vǝlakiyamvǝlǝg nǝ uud kǝ Shǝɗǝkwiin kiyava hǝɓǝga.
Vǝgh uuɓii pall bi nǝ iin biya, uuɓiyah ba ɗyak tǝ vakaiya,
Akwama tagadatag shig taaki, “ Ən dǝv bi nai biya, mbakyarvad kwaha ǝn, uuɓiya vǝgh bi nai biya,” Atar ba tagda kwana tsǝgarva bi kǝ nǝg kǝ uuɓiya vǝgh biya.
Bandkwah dlaɓ hyǝmi akwama tagadatag taakiya,“Ən gyi bi nai biya, kwakyarvad kwaha ǝn uuɓiya vǝgh bi nai biya,” Atar ba tagǝda ǝndkwaha tsǝgarva bi kǝ nǝg uuɓiya vǝgh biya.
Akwa maa baɗǝm nǝ vǝgh maa ba gyiya, maa da cinngav dǝ au nǝ ǝlbǝgi? Akwa maa baɗǝm nǝ vǝgh maa ba hyǝmiya, maa da shiyav dau nǝ dǝgiti?
Amma ɓadlǝghanaɓadlǝg Daadamazhigǝl aanji kwar kǝ uuɓiya vǝgh bandkwa kǝsghaaka nǝ iina.
Akwa maa baɗǝm nǝ vǝgh ba uuɓi palla, maa mǝr tǝmga vǝghi?
Iin wan kwana mǝnng nǝ uuɓiyah ba ɗyaka, amma vǝgh ba palla.
Tagarda bi gyi kǝ dǝv taakiya,“Maay lambar dǝ kǝgh biya,”Aanji ghǝr tagardai kǝ shigah taakiya,“Maay lambar dǝ kuuram biya.”
Əndkwah biya, uuɓiyahi vazav bandgi ar maay dǝ puutaatǝr biya, iitǝr wa mǝnng tlǝraatǝra.
Uuɓiya vǝghahi kiyam vazǝg nǝ miyam bandgi dǝti ndanngǝr da tǝ kyalmǝn biya, iitǝr wa kiyam fǝtǝraara nǝ miyama. Mbakyarvad kwaha uuɓiya vǝghahamiyami ghwaɗ kǝ vazǝg fǝvarnaafǝg marawuraana.
Uuɓiyaha vǝghahamiyamǝn maaraw kǝ Vazǝg naa bamma ɓagavtǝra dǝgit biya, maltlǝghantmatlǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ vǝgh vak palla, nǝdal kǝ uuɓiyahi nenenennen kǝ ndanngǝra
Aɗaba aa dzaar bi tagwazhatagwazh tǝ vǝgh biya, bamma uuɓiyah wa fa hyǝmi ma taatakatǝra.
Mbakyarvad kwaha akwama tlakǝnatlǝg nǝ uuɓii pal kǝ dlaɗa, baɗǝmmatǝra ar ma dlaɗa, akwama dlǝbavantdlǝɓǝg nǝ uuɓii palla, baɗǝmmatǝra ar ba hwaɗag ǝmtaɗa.
Baɗǝmmaruwa am vǝgha Kǝristi, ma kwararuwa am uuɓiyana.

Ma yaa dadda gatǝga, faafǝg Daadamazhigǝl kǝ zarhaɓǝlga Yesu kǝ dǝga zunngwa, dǝga buwa tlayanngaha, dǝga hǝkǝrɗa lii tsaga dǝgita, lii ɓa dǝgaha jappǝra, lii vǝlavtǝr vǝlga mbahuudaha, ard lii mǝlgaru kǝ uudaha, ard lii fa hyǝmi tǝ tlǝra yaa dadda gatǝga, ard lii sǝrga taa ghai shahshaha.
Baɗǝm ar ba zarhaɓǝlga Yesu ni? Baɗǝm ar ba tlayangah ni? Baɗǝm ar ba lii tsaga dǝgit ni? Nii baɗǝm ar ba lii ɓa dǝgaha jappǝr hi?
Baɗǝm ar ba dǝ vǝlga mbaha uudah ni? Baɗǝm ar ba sǝrgasǝrg kǝ taa ghaiyah shahshah ni? Nii baɗǝmmatǝr ha sǝrgasǝrg kǝ gwiya ghaiyah hi?
Kǝmamkǝmǝg kǝ vǝlgahi kwa ndannga, ǝn da markurmarg kǝ ɗuuli kwa juujig baɗǝm dǝ marawa.
